title: Time-bounded decision by an oracle machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $O$ and $L$ be languages of Boolean words, and let $T$ assign a nonnegative integer to each nonnegative integer. For every Boolean word $x$, the machine with oracle $O$ halts after exactly $T(|x|)$ steps and outputs the one-symbol word whose symbol is true exactly when $x\in L$.
